AUTHOR: Li, JY; Liu, CN; Wang, LH; Liu, Y; Li, R; Lu, XC; Lu, J; Shen, J
TITLE: Multi-species identification and number counting of fish passing through fishway at hydropower stations with LigTraNet
REGION: Fishway of Y Hydropower Station, Tibet, China
SPECIES: Schizothorax oconnori, Racoma waltoni, Schizothorax macropogon, Schizopygopsis younghusbandi, plus generic 'Fish' for tiny fish
DATA: Own fishway video, 2022 passage season (5374 key-frame images; 3 MOT16-format tracking videos; counting subset 15 May-15 June)
V_EV: Sec. 4.5: 'The deviation observed between the fishway monitoring method and manual counting results was primarily attributed to image blurring in high-turbidity scenarios'
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'This dataset was then divided into training and validation sets in an 8:2 ratio using a random selection process.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: dataset 'collected from the actual fishway of the Y Hydropower Station in Tibet, China, with data collected during the 2022 fish passage season'
C_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'detection thresholds of IoU = 0.3 and score = 0.3'; Table 6 reports IDSW per test video for LigTraNet and baselines.
E_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'The baseline data for calculating counting accuracy were derived from manual observations'; Table 7 manual count 1207 vs LigTraNet 1111 (92.0%).
ARCH: LigObNet (YOLOv8n modified with C1 module, depthwise separable conv, SimAM) + DeepSORT with counting line (LigTraNet)
METR: Precision, recall, mAP, Params, GFLOPs, FPS, memory; IDF1, IDSW, MOTA, MOTP; counting accuracy
NOTE: Detection evaluated on random 80/20 image split of key frames from same videos. Counting compared with two experts' manual counts of same footage. Sec. 4.4 states the method was applied at three hydropower stations with >90% accuracy after manual review, but no data/design details - not coded as external test. C5 coded from IDSW measured in MOT evaluation (Table 6); score threshold 0.3 given without sensitivity analysis -> C_ALL=Y via C5+C1 rule. Verifier: check whether IDSW measurement alone should qualify as C5.
